Description
The Chinese Gold Panda coin was first introduced in 1982 by the official mint of China. The Chinese Gold Panda is one of the world’s longest-running gold bullion programs. The Chinese 1 oz Gold Panda coin is one of the world’s most widely traded
bullion coins.
As the name suggests, each one of these coins has a single troy ounce of gold within it. The coins are all made of the highest purity gold, at .999. This means that they are most useful in terms of investment opportunities. Since you can use gold for a tremendous amount of hedges in the realm of business and as a physical safeguard for your wealth, large amounts of medium denomination coins, such as these, offer protection and potential.
Until the year 2000, the Chinese 1 oz Gold Panda coin was legal money in China and had a face value of 100 yuan. Chinese Gold Panda coins issued after that have a face value of 500 yuan. Except for 2001 and 2002, the design of the 1 oz Chinese Gold Panda coin changes every year.
Design of Chinese 1 oz Gold Panda coin
The design of the Chinese 1 oz Gold Panda coin is changed yearly, which makes it almost unique among the government minted coins. While the design of the Chinese panda gold coin is altered each year, it is always based on the Giant Panda, the iconic animal/symbol of the Chinese.
The obverse side of the Chinese 1 oz Gold Panda coin features the depiction of the
Temple of Heaven
is featured in the center, with a Chinese character on top that reads “Zhonghua Renmin Gongheguo,” which translates to “People’s Republic of China,” and the year of issuance on the bottom. The Temple of Heaven is located in South-Central Beijing and was built in the 15th century.
The reverse side of the panda gold coin features an innocent-looking panda as it lounges on a tree branch while preparing to eat some bamboo. The portrait of the Panda is changed each year except for the years 2001 and 2002 which features the same Gold Panda design. This is shown in a great deal of detail that will make any collector want to have at least one for their own uses.
Main Highlights of Chinese 1 oz Panda Gold Coin
Contains 1 troy oz of .999 pure gold.
Manufactured by Chinese Mint.
Each gold coin comes sealed in original mint plastic.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
On the obverse, features the depiction of the Temple of Heaven in the center with a Chinese character on top saying “Zhonghua Renmin Gongheguo”.
On the reverse,
features an innocent-looking panda.
Guaranteed by the People’s Bank of China.
